subject: literacy
concept: Recognizing common informational text structures: description, sequence, and compare/contrast
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts short informational passages into 'describes,' 'tells steps,' or 'compares' piles
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a graphic organizer shape (list, timeline, venn diagram) to the correct passage
exercise.abstract: Student identifies which text structure a given informational passage uses

misconception_flags: confuses sequence structure with simple description

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
